properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "400"
failureMessage = "Input validation failed"
failureError = "One or more create inputs are invalid."
failureResult = "{}"
organizationName = sys.argv[16]
deploymentName = sys.argv[17]
descriptionValue = sys.argv[3]
definitionName = sys.argv[18]
usePreferred = sys.argv[32] == "true"
versionText = sys.argv[33]
poolSelector = sys.argv[19]
instancePrefix = sys.argv[20]
startIndexText = sys.argv[34]
digitCountText = sys.argv[35]
blueprintsText = sys.argv[29] or "[]"
qualifiersText = sys.argv[30] or "[]"
scheduleSelector = sys.argv[21]
rollout = sys.argv[22]
tagsText = sys.argv[31] or "[]"
namePattern = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\- _]{0,31}$")
prefixPattern = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9\-_]{0,31}$")
errors = []
if not organizationName:
    errors.append("Workload Organization must not be blank.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(deploymentName):
    errors.append("Workload Deployment Name must be 1-32 supported characters and start alphanumerically.")
if len(descriptionValue) > 1024 or (descriptionValue and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9]", descriptionValue)):
    errors.append("Description must be at most 1024 characters and, when nonempty, start alphanumerically.")
if not namePattern.fullmatch(definitionName):
    errors.append("Workload Definition Name is invalid.")
try:
    definitionVersion = int(versionText)
except Exception:
    definitionVersion = 0
if not usePreferred and definitionVersion < 1:
    errors.append("Workload Definition Version must be at least 1 when preferred version is false.")
if not poolSelector:
    errors.append("Resource Pool Name or Moid must not be blank.")
if not prefixPattern.fullmatch(instancePrefix):
    errors.append("Workload Instance Prefix must be 1-32 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores and start alphanumerically.")
try:
    startIndex = int(startIndexText)
except Exception:
    startIndex = 0
if startIndex < 1:
    errors.append("Start Index for Suffix must be at least 1.")
try:
    digitCount = int(digitCountText)
except Exception:
    digitCount = 0
if digitCount < 1 or digitCount > 4:
    errors.append("Digit Count must be from 1 through 4.")
if rollout not in {"Batch","Canary"}:
    errors.append("Rollout Strategy must be Batch or Canary.")
try:
    blueprints = json.loads(blueprintsText)
    qualifiers = json.loads(qualifiersText)
    tags = json.loads(tagsText)
    if not isinstance(blueprints, list) or not isinstance(qualifiers, list) or not isinstance(tags, list):
        raise ValueError("Blueprint overrides, qualifiers, and tags must each be JSON arrays.")
    for tag in tags:
        if not isinstance(tag, dict) or not set(tag).issubset({"Key","Value"}) or not isinstance(tag.get("Key"), str) or not (1 <= len(tag["Key"]) <= 356) or not isinstance(tag.get("Value",""), str) or len(tag.get("Value","")) > 256:
            raise ValueError("Each tag must contain only a 1-356 character Key and optional Value of at most 256 characters.")
except Exception as exc:
    blueprints = qualifiers = tags = []
    errors.append("JSON input validation failed: " + str(exc))
escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[23]
escapedDeploymentName = sys.argv[24]
escapedDefinitionName = sys.argv[25]
escapedPoolSelector = sys.argv[26]
escapedInstancePrefix = sys.argv[27]
escapedScheduleSelector = sys.argv[28]
definitionClause = "PreferredVersion eq true" if usePreferred else "Version eq " + str(definitionVersion)
blueprintsJson = json.dumps(blueprints, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
qualifiersJson = json.dumps(qualifiers, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
tagsJson = json.dumps(tags, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
usePreferredText = "true" if usePreferred else "false"
scheduleSupplied = "true" if scheduleSelector else "false"
if errors:
    failureError = " ".join(errors)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))
else:
    status = "ready"
    failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
    failureResult = "{}"

import json
import re
import sys
status = 'invalid'
failureCode = '502'
failureMessage = 'Workload definition response was invalid'
failureError = 'The selected definition could not be validated.'
failureResult = '{}'
definitionMoid = ''
definitionJson = ''
expectedName = sys.argv[1]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[2]
usePreferred = sys.argv[6] == 'true'
expectedVersion = int(sys.argv[4])
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
    results = envelope.get('Results') if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError('Results is not an array.')
    if len(results) == 0:
        failureCode = '404'
        failureMessage = 'Workload definition was not found'
        failureError = 'The exact name/version selection returned zero matches.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureMessage, 'matchCount': 0}, separators=(',', ':'))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureCode = '409'
        failureMessage = 'Definition version selection was ambiguous'
        failureError = 'The exact definition selector returned ' + str(len(results)) + ' matches; exactly one is required. Multiple preferred versions are refused.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureMessage, 'matchCount': len(results)}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get('ClassId') != 'workload.WorkloadDefinition' or item.get('ObjectType') != 'workload.WorkloadDefinition':
            raise ValueError('The selected result is not a concrete WorkloadDefinition.')
        definitionMoid = str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(definitionMoid) or str(item.get('Name', '')).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError('Definition identity does not match.')
        organization = item.get('Organization')
        if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get('Moid', '')).strip() != organizationMoid or str(organization.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'organization.Organization':
            raise ValueError('Definition Organization relationship does not match.')
        if usePreferred and item.get('PreferredVersion') is not True:
            raise ValueError('The selected definition is not marked PreferredVersion.')
        if not usePreferred and item.get('Version') != expectedVersion:
            raise ValueError('The selected definition Version does not match.')
        validation = item.get('ValidationInformation')
        if not isinstance(validation, dict) or validation.get('State') != 'Valid':
            failureCode = '422'
            failureMessage = 'Workload definition is not valid'
            failureError = 'The selected definition ValidationInformation.State is not Valid.'
            failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureMessage, 'ValidationInformation': validation}, separators=(',', ':'))
        else:
            definitionJson = json.dumps(item, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
            status = 'ready'
            failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ''
            failureResult = '{}'
except Exception as exc:
    if failureCode == '502':
        failureError = 'The definition response failed validation: ' + str(exc)
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureMessage, 'details': failureError}, separators=(',', ':'))

import json
import re
import sys

status = "invalid"
failureCode = "502"
failureMessage = "Related resource response was invalid"
failureError = "The exact relationship target could not be validated."
failureResult = "{}"
resourceMoid = ""
selector = sys.argv[1]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[2]
expectedType = sys.argv[3]
label = sys.argv[4]
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
    results = envelope.get("Results") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("Results is not an array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        failureCode = "404"
        failureMessage = label + " was not found"
        failureError = "The exact name-or-Moid lookup returned zero matches."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":0,"Selector":selector}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        failureCode = "409"
        failureMessage = label + " lookup was ambiguous"
        failureError = "The name-or-Moid lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"Selector":selector}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("ClassId") != expectedType or item.get("ObjectType") != expectedType:
            raise ValueError("The result concrete type does not match " + expectedType + ".")
        resourceMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(resourceMoid):
            raise ValueError("The related resource Moid is missing or unsafe.")
        if resourceMoid != selector and str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != selector:
            raise ValueError("Neither returned Moid nor Name matches the selector exactly.")
        organization = item.get("Organization")
        if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get("Moid","")).strip() != organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The related resource Organization relationship does not match.")
        status = "ready"
        failureCode = failureMessage = failureError = ""
        failureResult = "{}"
except Exception as exc:
    if failureCode == "502":
        failureError = label + " response failed validation: " + str(exc)
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureMessage,"details":failureError}, separators=(",",":"))
